subject: Request: transitional resilience credit plan for intermittent latency spikes
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@greenstream.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@greenstream.com, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 09 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Repeated nightly latency spikes — request for remediation and compensation

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

Quick summary: since last Wednesday our nightly ingestion jobs have hit intermittent latency spikes (~8–12s p95 for tokenization RPCs) that caused 3 separate batch windows to time out. We attached the incident export from our side so you can see the windowed failures (greenstream-slo-incident-log.csv).

Impact: this blocked downstream ETL and delayed reporting to our customers; platform engineers flagged the pattern as a regression from the pilot baseline. We appreciate the engineering team's triage so far, but we need a clear remediation timeline and an accommodation for the production impact while the fix is validated.

Request: please outline a package you can offer (credits, temporary capacity, or other concessions) while you stabilize the service. Procurement is looped to help expedite approval if we can land on a concrete proposal.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Nguyen
Head of Platform
Greenstream Inc.

Attachments: greenstream-slo-incident-log.csv (CSV, 120KB)

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 09 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Repeated nightly latency spikes — request for remediation and compensation

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Greenstream's escalation. They've sent incident logs and want a remediation + compensation package. Quick proposed offer below; attaching a draft "transitional credit schedule" for legal/finance review.

Proposed Transitional Resilience Credit Plan (initial ask to exec):
- Two-month tiered credit: 20% service credit off hosted usage for May & June, applied pro rata to invoices.
- One month of dedicated pilot capacity (equivalent to their current committed throughput) at no charge to help absorb load spikes while our fixes roll out.
- 100 expedited support credits (for priority triage and 24/7 on-call for one month).
- Conditional: credits issued once remediation steps are agreed and a short validation plan (SLO rollback/testing plan) is accepted by both parties.

Why this structure: gives Greenstream near-term relief while limiting long-term financial exposure; the dedicated pilot month speeds mitigation and reduces recurrence risk.

Attachments: proposed_transitional_credit_schedule.pdf (proposal)

Can we get an approver on this today? If you want different bounds (cap, duration) say so and I'll update the draft to send to procurement.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 09 May 2026 12:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Repeated nightly latency spikes — request for remediation and compensation

Thanks for the draft, Priyom. I like the structure but suggest tightening the financial exposure and adding an objective validation gate. My notes: 

- Cap the credit pool to $35k total (so we avoid an open-ended billing hit).
- Convert the one month free Dedicated to a capped "migration assist month" (equivalent of up to 1x their current reservation) and require a short joint runbook to be signed before provisioning.
- Make the support credits explicit: 100 credits = up to eight 4-hour priority sessions (to avoid open-ended on-call).
- Add a 30-day remediation validation: if we hit a second set of spikes after fixes, we escalate to a supplemental remedial payment (this is standard).

If OK, we need Karthik/Finance to sign off on cap and the doc language. Also want legal to review the proposed_transitional_credit_schedule.pdf for wording around conditional issuance.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 16:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Repeated nightly latency spikes — request for remediation and compensation

Marissa / Priyom — reviewed. Approve the transitional resilience credit plan with the cap and runbook guardrails Marissa suggested. Key points for execution:

- Approved concession: up to $35,000 in total credits (applied as described), plus one month migration-assist Dedicated capacity (capped to their current committed profile).
- Approval conditioned on: signed runbook + validation test plan; joint post-mitigation review within 30 days.
- Finance to record as one-off concession against Q2 commercial allowances, legal to sign the PDF and we publish the credit in the billing system post-validation.

Priyom — you can send the formal offer to Alice and procurement. Put the offer in a short bullet email, attach the legal PDF as "transitional_credit_schedule_signed_for_exec_review.pdf" (we'll get it signed by Legal). Copy me on that outbound.

I'll mark this as an approved exec concession; finance will confirm the accounting flow tomorrow.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
